name: sutra
description: Sutra — a governed personal knowledge substrate. Your AI can reason over everything you know, and provably cannot leak what you marked private.

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/core packages/mcp packages/cli packages/daemon packages/dashboard
scripts.build:clean: tsc --build --clean packages/core packages/mcp packages/cli packages/daemon packages/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist packages/mcp/dist packages/cli/dist packages/daemon/dist
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:license && npm run check:no-bun && npm run leak-scan && npm run check:core-alone
